notes: 两项改动：①自动同步仅在主动关闭 DSH 窗口（×）时触发——scheduleAutoStart 只做 drift 状态更新，handleSettings 只排队 watcher（shouldCloseDsh: false）不自动退出，只有 triggerAutoSyncOnClose（× 关闭/页面卸载）走 shouldCloseDsh: true 真正关闭 DSH；②项目级技能纳入同步——工作区 .dsh/skills/ 下的项目技能之前因 .dsh 整目录被忽略而永远不同步，现在 Test-WorkspaceIgnored 给 .dsh/skills/ 开定向例外，其余 .dsh 内容仍跳过。保留 0.3.93-0.3.101 全部修复。
notesEn: Two changes: ①Auto sync only triggers when user actively closes the DSH window (× close) — scheduleAutoStart only checks drift and updates status, handleSettings only queues watcher (shouldCloseDsh: false) without auto-close, only triggerAutoSyncOnClose (× close / pagehide) uses shouldCloseDsh: true to actually close DSH; ②Project-level skills now sync — skills under a workspace's .dsh/skills/ were never synced because .dsh was entirely ignored; Test-WorkspaceIgnored now makes a targeted exception for .dsh/skills/, other .dsh content stays skipped. Keeps all 0.3.93-0.3.101 fixes.
